clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Orphan Matron Battlewail cares for children left without families by war. With Tosamina, she gives them shelter and raises young orcs.

Orphan Matron Battlewail cares for children who have lost their kin to violence. In Orgrimmar, where war's toll reaches even the young capital, she and Tosamina shelter and nurture the next generation of the Horde. The orphanage in the Valley of Honor opens its doors to passing adventurers. During Children's Week, travelers are called upon to mentor the children.
